# cogs/absence_staff.py
"""
Module de commande /absence_staff pour la gestion des absences du staff.
- Date de début automatique (aujourd'hui)
- L'utilisateur rentre: type, date de fin, raison
- Affiche le rôle le plus haut avec couleur personnalisée
- Modifie le message avec ✅ quand l'absence se termine
"""
import discord
from discord.ext import commands, tasks
from discord import app_commands, Interaction, ui
import json
import os
import re
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Optional

# Configuration
TARGET_GUILD_ID = 1188506879052238988
ABSENCES_CHANNEL_ID = 1308539884528472075
STAFF_ROLE_IDS = {1188508232470245427, 1188507134644731915}
OWNER_ID = 653038666625785866


class ConfirmAbsenceView(ui.View):
    """View ephemeral pour confirmer la fin de l'absence."""

    def __init__(self, cog: "AbsenceStaffCog", absence_id: str, user_id: int, timeout: float = 180.0):
        super().__init__(timeout=timeout)
        self.cog = cog
        self.absence_id = absence_id
        self.user_id = user_id

    async def interaction_check(self, interaction: Interaction) -> bool:
        """Vérifier que seul l'auteur peut utiliser les boutons."""
        if interaction.user.id != self.user_id:
            await interaction.response.send_message(
                "❌ Tu ne peux pas utiliser ce bouton.",
                ephemeral=True,
            )
            return False
        return True

    @ui.button(label="✅ Confirmer", style=discord.ButtonStyle.green)
    async def confirm_button(self, interaction: Interaction, button: ui.Button) -> None:
        """Bouton de confirmation."""
        await interaction.response.defer()
        
        try:
            absences = self.cog.load_absences()
            
            if self.absence_id not in absences:
                await interaction.followup.send(
                    "❌ Absence non trouvée.",
                    ephemeral=True,
                )
                return
            
            absence_data = absences[self.absence_id]
            guild = self.cog.bot.get_guild(absence_data["guild_id"])
            
            if guild:
                channel = guild.get_channel(absence_data["channel_id"])
                if channel:
                    try:
                        message = await channel.fetch_message(absence_data["message_id"]) # type: ignore
                        
                        # Modifier l'embed avec ✅
                        if message.embeds:
                            embed = message.embeds[0]
                            user_name = absence_data.get("user_name", "Utilisateur")
                            embed.title = f"✅ Absence de @{user_name} terminée"
                            embed.color = 0x00ff00
                            embed.set_footer(text=f"✅ Terminée • Equipe miaoscule")
                            await message.edit(embed=embed, view=None)
                            # Ajouter la réaction ✅
                            await message.add_reaction("✅")
                    except Exception as e:
                        print(f"❌ Erreur modification message: {e}")
            
            # Marquer comme notifiée
            absence_data["notified"] = True
            absences[self.absence_id] = absence_data
            self.cog.save_absences(absences)
            
            # Envoyer un DM privé à l'utilisateur
            try:
                user = await self.cog.bot.fetch_user(absence_data["user_id"])
                if user:
                    embed = discord.Embed(
                        title="✅ Absence terminée",
                        description=f"Ton absence sur le serveur staff est désormais terminée.",
                        color=0x00ff00,
                        timestamp=datetime.now(timezone.utc)
                    )
                    embed.add_field(name="📋 Raison", value=absence_data['raison'], inline=False)
                    embed.add_field(name="👑 Rôle", value=absence_data['role_name'], inline=True)
                    embed.set_footer(text="Bon retour parmi nous ! • Miaouscle Bot")
                    await user.send(embed=embed)
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"❌ Erreur envoi DM: {e}")
            
            await interaction.followup.send(
                "✅ Absence terminée avec succès!",
                ephemeral=True,
            )
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"❌ Erreur confirmation absence: {e}")
            await interaction.followup.send(
                f"❌ Erreur: {str(e)}",
                ephemeral=True,
            )

    @ui.button(label="❌ Annuler", style=discord.ButtonStyle.red)
    async def cancel_button(self, interaction: Interaction, button: ui.Button) -> None:
        """Bouton d'annulation."""
        await interaction.response.send_message(
            "❌ Annulé.",
            ephemeral=True,
        )


class FinishAbsenceButtonView(ui.View):
    """View avec bouton 'Finir maintenant' pour terminer l'absence."""

    def __init__(self, cog: "AbsenceStaffCog", absence_id: str, user_id: int, timeout: float = None):
        super().__init__(timeout=timeout)
        self.cog = cog
        self.absence_id = absence_id
        self.user_id = user_id

    async def interaction_check(self, interaction: Interaction) -> bool:
        """Vérifier que seul l'auteur peut utiliser le bouton."""
        if interaction.user.id != self.user_id:
            # Message d'erreur ephemeral
            try:
                await interaction.response.defer(ephemeral=True)
                absences = self.cog.load_absences()
                absence_data = absences.get(self.absence_id, {})
                absence_author = absence_data.get("user_name", "Inconnu")
                await interaction.followup.send(
                    f"❌ Tu n'es pas autorisé! Cette absence appartient à **{absence_author}**.",
                    ephemeral=True,
                )
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"❌ Erreur vérification bouton: {e}")
            return False
        return True

    @ui.button(label="⏹️ Finir maintenant", style=discord.ButtonStyle.blurple)
    async def finish_button(self, interaction: Interaction, button: ui.Button) -> None:
        """Affiche une confirmation ephemeral."""
        # Créer la view de confirmation ephemeral
        confirm_view = ConfirmAbsenceView(self.cog, self.absence_id, self.user_id)
        
        await interaction.response.send_message(
            "🔔 Confirmer la fin de l'absence?",
            view=confirm_view,
            ephemeral=True,
        )


class AbsenceStaffCog(commands.Cog):
    """Cog pour la commande /absence_staff."""

    def __init__(self, bot: commands.Bot):
        self.bot = bot
        self.absences_file = 'web/data/staff_absences.json'
        os.makedirs('web/data', exist_ok=True)
        self.check_absence_end.start()

    def load_absences(self) -> dict:
        """Charge les absences depuis le fichier JSON."""
        try:
            if os.path.exists(self.absences_file):
                with open(self.absences_file, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
                    return json.load(f)
            return {}
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"❌ Erreur chargement absences: {e}")
            return {}

    def save_absences(self, absences: dict) -> None:
        """Sauvegarde les absences dans le fichier JSON."""
        try:
            os.makedirs('web/data', exist_ok=True)
            with open(self.absences_file, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
                json.dump(absences, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"❌ Erreur sauvegarde absences: {e}")

    def _validate_date_format(self, date_str: str) -> bool:
        """Valide le format JJ/MM/YYYY."""
        pattern = r'^\d{2}/\d{2}/\d{4}$'
        if not re.match(pattern, date_str):
            return False
        
        try:
            day, month, year = date_str.split('/')
            day_int = int(day)
            month_int = int(month)
            year_int = int(year)
            
            if not (1 <= day_int <= 31 and 1 <= month_int <= 12 and year_int >= 2000):
                return False
            return True
        except (ValueError, IndexError):
            return False

    def get_highest_colored_role(self, member: discord.Member) -> Optional[discord.Role]:
        """Récupère le rôle le plus haut avec couleur personnalisée."""
        highest_role = None
        highest_position = -1
        
        for role in member.roles:
            # Couleur personnalisée ET pas un rôle système
            if role.color != discord.Color.default() and not role.managed:
                if role.position > highest_position:
                    highest_position = role.position
                    highest_role = role
        
        return highest_role

    def format_date_display(self, date: datetime) -> str:
        """Formate la date pour l'affichage (JJ/MM/YYYY)."""
        return date.strftime("%d/%m/%Y")
    
    def has_active_absence(self, user_id: int) -> bool:
        """Vérifie si l'utilisateur a une absence active."""
        absences = self.load_absences()
        now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
        
        for absence_data in absences.values():
            if absence_data.get("user_id") == user_id and not absence_data.get("notified"):
                end_date = datetime.fromisoformat(absence_data["end_date"])
                if now < end_date:
                    return True
        return False

    @app_commands.command(
        name="absence_staff",
        description="Déclarer une absence du staff",
    )
    @app_commands.guild_only()
    @app_commands.describe(
        end_date="Date de fin (JJ/MM/YYYY)",
        raison="Motif de l'absence",
    )
    async def absence_staff(
        self,
        interaction: Interaction,
        end_date: str,
        raison: str,
    ) -> None:
        """Déclare une absence du staff."""
        await interaction.response.defer(ephemeral=True)

        try:
            # Vérifier le serveur
            if interaction.guild_id != TARGET_GUILD_ID:
                await interaction.followup.send(
                    "⛔ Cette commande n'est disponible que sur le serveur staff.",
                    ephemeral=True,
                )
                return

            # Vérifier les rôles requis
            if isinstance(interaction.user, discord.Member):
                has_role = any(role.id in STAFF_ROLE_IDS for role in interaction.user.roles)
                if not has_role and interaction.user.id != OWNER_ID:
                    await interaction.followup.send(
                        "⛔ Tu dois avoir l'un des rôles staff autorisés.",
                        ephemeral=True,
                    )
                    return
            else:
                await interaction.followup.send(
                    "⛔ Cette commande ne fonctionne que sur un serveur.",
                    ephemeral=True,
                )
                return

            # Valider la date de fin - Format: JJ/MM/YYYY
            if not self._validate_date_format(end_date):
                await interaction.followup.send(
                    "❌ Format de date invalide. Format requis: JJ/MM/YYYY (ex: 30/11/2025)",
                    ephemeral=True,
                )
                return

            # Vérifier si l'utilisateur a déjà une absence active
            if self.has_active_absence(interaction.user.id):
                await interaction.followup.send(
                    "⚠️ Tu as déjà une absence en cours. Termine-la d'abord avec le bouton '⏹️ Finir maintenant' avant d'en déclarer une nouvelle.",
                    ephemeral=True,
                )
                return
            
            # Date de début = aujourd'hui (auto-détectée)
            start = datetime.now(timezone.utc).replace(hour=0, minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0)
            
            # Parser la date de fin
            try:
                # Créer la date à minuit du jour sélectionné
                end = datetime.strptime(end_date, "%d/%m/%Y").replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
            except ValueError:
                await interaction.followup.send(
                    "❌ Date invalide. Utilise le format: JJ/MM/YYYY",
                    ephemeral=True,
                )
                return

            if start >= end:
                await interaction.followup.send(
                    "❌ La date de fin doit être après aujourd'hui.",
                    ephemeral=True,
                )
                return

            # Récupérer le serveur et l'auteur (interaction.user)
            guild = interaction.guild
            if not guild:
                await interaction.followup.send("❌ Erreur: serveur non trouvé.", ephemeral=True)
                return

            # Récupérer le member qui utilise la commande
            member = interaction.user
            if not isinstance(member, discord.Member):
                member = await guild.fetch_member(interaction.user.id)
                if not member:
                    await interaction.followup.send(
                        "❌ Erreur: impossible de récupérer ton profil.",
                        ephemeral=True,
                    )
                    return

            # Récupérer le rôle le plus haut avec couleur
            highest_role = self.get_highest_colored_role(member)
            if not highest_role:
                await interaction.followup.send(
                    f"❌ Tu n'as pas de rôle staff avec couleur personnalisée.",
                    ephemeral=True,
                )
                return

            # Créer l'embed avec le style de la photo
            embed = discord.Embed(
                title="Absence déclarée",
                color=0x2F3136,
            )
            
            # Pseudo avec ID
            embed.add_field(
                name="👤 Pseudo :",
                value=f"{member.mention} – ({member.id})",
                inline=False,
            )
            
            # Rôle le plus élevé (avec couleur du rôle)
            embed.add_field(
                name="👑 Rôle le plus élevé :",
                value=highest_role.mention,
                inline=False,
            )
            
            # Fin de l'absence - Discord Timestamp (juste la date)
            end_timestamp = int(end.timestamp())
            embed.add_field(
                name="⏰ Fin :",
                value=f"<t:{end_timestamp}:D>",
                inline=False,
            )
            
            # Raison
            embed.add_field(
                name="📝 Raison :",
                value=raison,
                inline=False,
            )
            
            embed.set_thumbnail(url=member.avatar.url if member.avatar else None)
            embed.set_footer(text=f"Equipe miaoscule • Absence staff")

            # Envoyer dans le canal d'absences
            logs_channel = guild.get_channel(ABSENCES_CHANNEL_ID)
            if not logs_channel:
                await interaction.followup.send(
                    f"❌ Canal <#{ABSENCES_CHANNEL_ID}> introuvable.",
                    ephemeral=True,
                )
                return

            try:
                # Créer la view avec juste le bouton "Finir maintenant"
                absence_id = f"{member.id}_{int(start.timestamp())}"
                view = FinishAbsenceButtonView(self, absence_id, member.id)
                message = await logs_channel.send(embed=embed, view=view)
            except discord.Forbidden:
                await interaction.followup.send(
                    f"❌ Je n'ai pas la permission d'envoyer dans <#{ABSENCES_CHANNEL_ID}>.",
                    ephemeral=True,
                )
                return

            # Sauvegarder l'absence
            absences = self.load_absences()
            absences[absence_id] = {
                "user_id": member.id,
                "user_name": member.name,
                "start_date": start.isoformat(),
                "end_date": end.isoformat(),
                "raison": raison,
                "role_name": highest_role.name,
                "guild_id": guild.id,
                "message_id": message.id,
                "channel_id": logs_channel.id,
                "created_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
                "notified": False,
            }
            self.save_absences(absences)

            await interaction.followup.send(
                f"✅ Absence enregistrée",
                ephemeral=True,
            )

        except Exception as e:
            print(f"❌ Erreur /absence_staff: {e}")
            await interaction.followup.send(
                f"❌ Erreur: {str(e)}",
                ephemeral=True,
            )

    @tasks.loop(hours=1)
    async def check_absence_end(self) -> None:
        """Vérifie si les absences se terminent."""
        try:
            absences = self.load_absences()
            now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
            updated = False

            for absence_id, absence_data in list(absences.items()):
                if absence_data.get("notified"):
                    continue

                end_date = datetime.fromisoformat(absence_data["end_date"])

                if now >= end_date:
                    guild = self.bot.get_guild(absence_data.get("guild_id", TARGET_GUILD_ID))
                    if guild:
                        try:
                            # Récupérer le message original
                            channel_id = absence_data.get("channel_id", ABSENCES_CHANNEL_ID)
                            channel = guild.get_channel(channel_id)
                            if channel:
                                try:
                                    message = await channel.fetch_message(absence_data["message_id"]) # type: ignore
                                    
                                    # Modifier l'embed avec ✅
                                    if message.embeds:
                                        embed = message.embeds[0]
                                        user_name = absence_data.get("user_name", "Utilisateur")
                                        embed.title = f"✅ Absence de @{user_name} terminée"
                                        embed.color = 0x00ff00
                                        embed.set_footer(text=f"✅ Terminée • Equipe miaoscule")
                                        await message.edit(embed=embed, view=None)
                                        # Ajouter la réaction ✅
                                        await message.add_reaction("✅")
                                    
                                    # Envoyer un DM privé à l'utilisateur
                                    try:
                                        user = await self.bot.fetch_user(absence_data["user_id"])
                                        if user:
                                            embed = discord.Embed(
                                                title="✅ Absence terminée",
                                                description=f"Ton absence sur le serveur staff est désormais terminée.",
                                                color=0x00ff00,
                                                timestamp=datetime.now(timezone.utc)
                                            )
                                            embed.add_field(name="📋 Raison", value=absence_data['raison'], inline=False)
                                            embed.add_field(name="👑 Rôle", value=absence_data['role_name'], inline=True)
                                            embed.set_footer(text="Bon retour parmi nous ! • Miaouscle Bot")
                                            await user.send(embed=embed)
                                    except Exception as e:
                                        print(f"❌ Erreur envoi DM: {e}")
                                except Exception as e:
                                    print(f"❌ Erreur modification message: {e}")

                            absence_data["notified"] = True
                            updated = True
                        except Exception as e:
                            print(f"❌ Erreur fin absence: {e}")

            if updated:
                self.save_absences(absences)

        except Exception as e:
            print(f"❌ Erreur check_absence_end: {e}")

    @check_absence_end.before_loop
    async def before_check_absence_end(self) -> None:
        """Attendre que le bot soit prêt."""
        await self.bot.wait_until_ready()


async def setup(bot: commands.Bot) -> None:
    """Charge le cog."""
    await bot.add_cog(AbsenceStaffCog(bot))

import discord

import json

import time as _monotonic

class InactivityView(discord.ui.View):
    """Vue de base: le timer se réinitialise à chaque interaction (inactivité réelle)"""

    def _reset_inactivity_timer(self):
        """Remet le compteur à zéro — appeler au début de chaque interaction acceptée"""
        if self.timeout is not None:
            try:
                self._View__timeout_expiry = _monotonic.monotonic() + self.timeout
            except AttributeError:
                pass

    async def interaction_check(self, interaction: discord.Interaction) -> bool:
        self._reset_inactivity_timer()
        return True

                    color=0xff6600

        self._reset_inactivity_timer()

            TIER_FREE, TIER_PREMIUM, TIER_PREMIUM_PLUS,

            guild = self.message.guild
        elif hasattr(self.admin_user, 'guild') and self.admin_user.guild:

        # ─── Statut Premium (couleur + bandeau discret) ──────────────────

        # ─── Compteur d'options configurées ──────────────────────────────
        tracked_keys = [
            "welcome_channel", "goodbye_channel", "log_channel",
            "nickname_request_channel", "welcome_message", "goodbye_message",
            "booster_role", "language", "automod_enabled",
        ]
        configured = sum(1 for k in tracked_keys if config.get(k))
        total = len(tracked_keys)
        bar_filled = int((configured / total) * 12)
        progress_bar = "█" * bar_filled + "░" * (12 - bar_filled)

        # ─── Header épuré ────────────────────────────────────────────────
        guild_name = guild.name if guild else "ce serveur"
        embed = discord.Embed(
            title="Panneau de configuration",
            description=(
                f"### {guild_name}\n"
                f"Plan · **{tier_badge}**\n"
                f"`{progress_bar}` **{configured}/{total}** options configurées\n"
                f"\u200b"
            ),
            color=color,
        )
        if guild and guild.icon:
            embed.set_thumbnail(url=guild.icon.url)

        # Helpers
        def pill(value, fallback="—"):
            return value if value else f"`{fallback}`"

        # ─── Salons ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
        welcome_ch = config.get("welcome_channel")
        goodbye_ch = config.get("goodbye_channel")
        log_ch = config.get("log_channel")
        nick_ch = config.get("nickname_request_channel")

        salons_value = (
            f"**Bienvenue** · {pill(f'<#{welcome_ch}>' if welcome_ch else None)}\n"
            f"**Départs** · {pill(f'<#{goodbye_ch}>' if goodbye_ch else None)}\n"
            f"**Logs** · {pill(f'<#{log_ch}>' if log_ch else None)}\n"
            f"**Demandes pseudo** · {pill(f'<#{nick_ch}>' if nick_ch else None)}"
        )
        embed.add_field(name="Salons", value=salons_value, inline=False)

        # ─── Messages ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
        def short(txt, maxlen=60):
            if not txt:
                return "`par défaut`"
            txt = str(txt)
            return f"`{txt[:maxlen] + '…' if len(txt) > maxlen else txt}`"

        msg_value = (
            f"**Bienvenue** · {short(config.get('welcome_message'))}\n"
            f"**Au revoir** · {short(config.get('goodbye_message'))}"
        )
        embed.add_field(name="Messages", value=msg_value, inline=False)

        # ─── Personnalisation Premium ────────────────────────────────────
        if tier == TIER_FREE:
            premium_value = (
                "Verrouillé — passe **Premium** pour personnaliser titre, "
                "couleur, image, footer, ping et MP de bienvenue.\n"
                "[Débloquer Premium](https://a7a54eed-3c9d-44cc-9bb5-f542e450c08d-00-7wjyd8rom8cz.janeway.replit.dev/premium)"
            )
        else:
            def state(prefix):
                bits = []
                if config.get(f"{prefix}_title"): bits.append("titre")
                if c := config.get(f"{prefix}_color"): bits.append(f"`{c}`")
                if config.get(f"{prefix}_image"): bits.append("image")
                if config.get(f"{prefix}_footer"): bits.append("footer")
                ping_default = True if prefix == "welcome" else False
                ping_v = config.get(f"{prefix}_ping", ping_default)
                bits.append("ping on" if ping_v else "ping off")
                return " · ".join(bits) if bits else "`par défaut`"

            premium_value = (
                f"**Bienvenue** · {state('welcome')}\n"
                f"**Au revoir** · {state('goodbye')}"
            )
            if tier == TIER_PREMIUM_PLUS:
                dm_on = bool(config.get("welcome_dm_enabled", False))
                premium_value += f"\n**MP bienvenue** · {'activé' if dm_on else 'désactivé'}"
            else:
                premium_value += "\n**MP bienvenue** · *Premium+ requis*"

        embed.add_field(name="Personnalisation Premium", value=premium_value, inline=False)

        # ─── Système ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
        booster_role = config.get("booster_role")
        if booster_role:
            try:
                booster_role = int(booster_role) if isinstance(booster_role, str) else booster_role
            except Exception:
                booster_role = None
        booster_text = f"<@&{booster_role}>" if booster_role else "`—`"

        language_code = config.get("language", "fr")
        language_name = SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES.get(language_code, "🇫🇷 Français")
        automod_on = bool(config.get("automod_enabled", True))

        sys_value = (
            f"**Langue** · {language_name}\n"
            f"**Booster XP** · {booster_text}\n"
            f"**Automod** · {'activé' if automod_on else 'désactivé'}"
        )
        embed.add_field(name="Système", value=sys_value, inline=False)

        # ─── Footer ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
        embed.set_footer(text="Choisis une catégorie dans le menu • Session 60s")
        embed.timestamp = discord.utils.utcnow()

        return embed

    async def config_select(self, interaction: discord.Interaction):

class MessageModal(discord.ui.Modal):
    def __init__(self, config_key, title, view):
        super().__init__(title=f"Configurer {title}")
        self.config_key = config_key
        self.view = view

        # Récupérer le message actuel s'il existe
        guild_id = 0
        if hasattr(view, 'admin_user') and view.admin_user and hasattr(view.admin_user, 'guild') and view.admin_user.guild:
            guild_id = view.admin_user.guild.id
        config = load_config(guild_id)
        current_message = config.get(config_key, "")

        self.message_input = discord.ui.TextInput(
            label=get_text(0, "admin.config.modal_message_label"),
            placeholder=get_text(0, "admin.config.modal_message_placeholder"),
            required=True,
            style=discord.TextStyle.paragraph,
            max_length=1000,
            default=current_message if current_message else ""
        )
        self.add_item(self.message_input)

    async def on_submit(self, interaction: discord.Interaction):
        if not interaction.guild:
            return

        message = self.message_input.value.strip()

        if not message:
            embed = create_embed(
                "Erreur ❌",
                "Le message ne peut pas être vide.",
                0xff0000
            )
            await interaction.response.send_message(embed=embed, ephemeral=True)
            return

        # Sauvegarder le message
        config = load_config(interaction.guild.id)
        config[self.config_key] = message
        save_config(interaction.guild.id, config)
        print(f"✅ MESSAGE SAVED: {self.config_key} = {message[:50]}... for guild {interaction.guild.id}")
        
        # Rafraîchir le menu principal avec les changements
        embed = self.view.get_config_embed(interaction.guild.id)
        await interaction.response.edit_message(
            embed=embed,
            view=self.view
        )
        await interaction.followup.send(f"✅ Message configuré avec succès!", ephemeral=True)

        self.field = discord.ui.TextInput(
            label=label[:45],
            placeholder=placeholder[:100] if placeholder else "Laisse vide pour utiliser la valeur par défaut",
            required=False,
            style=discord.TextStyle.paragraph if paragraph else discord.TextStyle.short,
            max_length=max_length,
            default=str(current)[:max_length] if current else "",
        )
        self.add_item(self.field)

    async def on_submit(self, interaction: discord.Interaction):
        if not interaction.guild:
            return
        value = self.field.value.strip()

        # Validation couleur (#RRGGBB)
        if self.config_key.endswith("_color") and value:
            v = value if value.startswith("#") else f"#{value}"
            if len(v) != 7 or any(c not in "0123456789abcdefABCDEF" for c in v[1:]):
                await interaction.response.send_message(
                    "❌ Couleur invalide. Utilise un code hex `#RRGGBB` (ex: `#00ff00`).",
                    ephemeral=True,
                )
                return
            value = v.lower()

        # Validation URL pour image
        if self.config_key.endswith("_image") and value:
            if not (value.startswith("http://") or value.startswith("https://")):
                await interaction.response.send_message(
                    "❌ URL d'image invalide. Doit commencer par `http://` ou `https://`.",
                    ephemeral=True,
                )
                return

        config = load_config(interaction.guild.id)
        if value:
            config[self.config_key] = value
        else:
            config.pop(self.config_key, None)
        save_config(interaction.guild.id, config)
        print(f"✅ PREMIUM SAVED: {self.config_key} = {str(value)[:50]} for guild {interaction.guild.id}")

        embed = self.parent_view.get_embed(interaction.guild.id)
        await interaction.response.edit_message(embed=embed, view=self.parent_view)


class PremiumCustomizeView(InactivityView):
    """Sous-vue Premium pour personnaliser l'embed welcome/goodbye."""

    def __init__(self, admin_user, parent_view, surface: str = "welcome"):
        super().__init__(timeout=60)
        self.admin_user = admin_user
        self.parent_view = parent_view
        self.surface = surface  # "welcome" | "goodbye"
        self._build()

    def _is_plus(self, guild_id: int) -> bool:
        try:
            from utils.premium import has_premium, TIER_PREMIUM_PLUS
            # Premium server-only : seul le tier du serveur compte.
            return has_premium(guild_id, 0, TIER_PREMIUM_PLUS)
        except Exception:
            return False

    def _build(self):
        self.clear_items()

        prefix = self.surface  # welcome|goodbye
        is_welcome = prefix == "welcome"

        # ─── Ligne 0 : Sélecteur Welcome/Goodbye ────────────────────────
        surface_select = discord.ui.Select(
            placeholder=("Tu personnalises : Bienvenue" if is_welcome else "Tu personnalises : Au Revoir"),
            options=[
                discord.SelectOption(
                    label="Message de bienvenue",
                    value="welcome",
                    description="Personnaliser l'arrivée des nouveaux membres",
                    default=is_welcome,
                ),
                discord.SelectOption(
                    label="Message d'au revoir",
                    value="goodbye",
                    description="Personnaliser le départ des membres",
                    default=not is_welcome,
                ),
            ],
            row=0,
        )

        async def _on_surface(interaction: discord.Interaction):
            values = interaction.data.get('values', []) if interaction.data else []
            if values:
                self.surface = values[0]
                self._build()
                await interaction.response.edit_message(
                    embed=self.get_embed(interaction.guild.id if interaction.guild else 0),
                    view=self,
                )

        surface_select.callback = _on_surface
        self.add_item(surface_select)

        # ─── Callbacks d'édition ────────────────────────────────────────
        async def _edit_title(i: discord.Interaction):
            await i.response.send_modal(PremiumFieldModal(self, f"{prefix}_title", "Titre de l'embed", max_length=256, placeholder="🎉 Bienvenue {user} !"))

        async def _edit_color(i: discord.Interaction):
            await i.response.send_modal(PremiumFieldModal(self, f"{prefix}_color", "Couleur (#RRGGBB)", max_length=7, placeholder="#00ff00"))

        async def _edit_image(i: discord.Interaction):
            await i.response.send_modal(PremiumFieldModal(self, f"{prefix}_image", "URL de l'image bannière", max_length=500, placeholder="https://exemple.com/img.png"))

        async def _edit_footer(i: discord.Interaction):
            await i.response.send_modal(PremiumFieldModal(self, f"{prefix}_footer", "Texte du footer", max_length=2048, placeholder="Membre #{count} • {guild}"))

        async def _toggle_ping(i: discord.Interaction):
            cfg = load_config(i.guild.id) if i.guild else {}
            key = f"{prefix}_ping"
            current = cfg.get(key, True if is_welcome else False)
            cfg[key] = not bool(current)
            if i.guild:
                save_config(i.guild.id, cfg)
            self._build()
            await i.response.edit_message(
                embed=self.get_embed(i.guild.id if i.guild else 0),
                view=self,
            )

        # ─── Ligne 1 : Titre + Couleur + Ping (l'essentiel) ─────────────
        cfg_now = load_config(self.admin_user.guild.id) if (hasattr(self.admin_user, 'guild') and self.admin_user.guild) else {}
        ping_active = cfg_now.get(f"{prefix}_ping", True if is_welcome else False)

        b_title = discord.ui.Button(label="Titre", style=discord.ButtonStyle.primary, emoji="📝", row=1)
        b_title.callback = _edit_title
        self.add_item(b_title)

        b_color = discord.ui.Button(label="Couleur", style=discord.ButtonStyle.primary, emoji="🎨", row=1)
        b_color.callback = _edit_color
        self.add_item(b_color)

        b_ping = discord.ui.Button(
            label=f"Ping : {'ON' if ping_active else 'OFF'}",
            style=discord.ButtonStyle.success if ping_active else discord.ButtonStyle.secondary,
            emoji="🔔" if ping_active else "🔕",
            row=1,
        )
        b_ping.callback = _toggle_ping
        self.add_item(b_ping)

        # ─── Ligne 2 : Image + Footer (visuels) ─────────────────────────
        b_image = discord.ui.Button(label="Image bannière", style=discord.ButtonStyle.primary, emoji="🖼️", row=2)
        b_image.callback = _edit_image
        self.add_item(b_image)

        b_footer = discord.ui.Button(label="Footer", style=discord.ButtonStyle.primary, emoji="🦶", row=2)
        b_footer.callback = _edit_footer
        self.add_item(b_footer)

        # ─── Ligne 3 : Section Premium+ (uniquement welcome) ────────────
        if is_welcome:
            guild_id = self.admin_user.guild.id if (hasattr(self.admin_user, 'guild') and self.admin_user.guild) else 0
            is_plus = self._is_plus(guild_id)
            dm_on = bool(cfg_now.get("welcome_dm_enabled", False))

            async def _toggle_dm(i: discord.Interaction):
                if not self._is_plus(i.guild.id if i.guild else 0):
                    await i.response.send_message("👑 Cette option nécessite **Premium+**.", ephemeral=True)
                    return
                cfg = load_config(i.guild.id) if i.guild else {}
                cfg["welcome_dm_enabled"] = not bool(cfg.get("welcome_dm_enabled", False))
                if i.guild:
                    save_config(i.guild.id, cfg)
                self._build()
                await i.response.edit_message(embed=self.get_embed(i.guild.id if i.guild else 0), view=self)

            async def _edit_dm(i: discord.Interaction):
                if not self._is_plus(i.guild.id if i.guild else 0):
                    await i.response.send_message("👑 Cette option nécessite **Premium+**.", ephemeral=True)
                    return
                await i.response.send_modal(PremiumFieldModal(self, "welcome_dm_message", "Texte du MP", max_length=1000, paragraph=True, placeholder="Bienvenue {user} sur {guild} ! Présente-toi en #présentations 😊"))

            b_dm_toggle = discord.ui.Button(
                label=("MP : ON" if dm_on else "MP : OFF") if is_plus else "MP de bienvenue",
                style=(discord.ButtonStyle.success if dm_on else discord.ButtonStyle.secondary) if is_plus else discord.ButtonStyle.secondary,
                emoji="👑",
                row=3,
                disabled=not is_plus,
            )
            b_dm_toggle.callback = _toggle_dm
            self.add_item(b_dm_toggle)

            b_dm_text = discord.ui.Button(
                label="Texte du MP",
                style=discord.ButtonStyle.primary if is_plus else discord.ButtonStyle.secondary,
                emoji="💌",
                row=3,
                disabled=not is_plus,
            )
            b_dm_text.callback = _edit_dm
            self.add_item(b_dm_text)

        # ─── Ligne 4 : Reset surface + Retour ───────────────────────────
        async def _reset_surface(i: discord.Interaction):
            cfg = load_config(i.guild.id) if i.guild else {}
            for key in (f"{prefix}_title", f"{prefix}_color", f"{prefix}_image", f"{prefix}_footer", f"{prefix}_ping"):
                cfg.pop(key, None)
            if is_welcome:
                cfg.pop("welcome_dm_enabled", None)
                cfg.pop("welcome_dm_message", None)
            if i.guild:
                save_config(i.guild.id, cfg)
            self._build()
            await i.response.edit_message(embed=self.get_embed(i.guild.id if i.guild else 0), view=self)

        async def _back(i: discord.Interaction):
            embed = self.parent_view.get_config_embed(i.guild.id if i.guild else 0)
            await i.response.edit_message(embed=embed, view=self.parent_view)

        b_reset = discord.ui.Button(label="Réinitialiser cette surface", style=discord.ButtonStyle.secondary, emoji="♻️", row=4)
        b_reset.callback = _reset_surface
        self.add_item(b_reset)

        b_back = discord.ui.Button(label="Retour au panneau", style=discord.ButtonStyle.danger, emoji="↩️", row=4)
        b_back.callback = _back
        self.add_item(b_back)

    def get_embed(self, guild_id: int) -> discord.Embed:
        """Embed de personnalisation Premium — design moderne et lisible."""
        from utils.premium import get_guild_tier, TIER_PREMIUM_PLUS
        cfg = load_config(guild_id) or {}
        prefix = self.surface
        is_welcome = prefix == "welcome"
        surface_label = "Bienvenue" if is_welcome else "Au revoir"

        tier = get_guild_tier(guild_id) if guild_id else "free"
        is_plus = tier == TIER_PREMIUM_PLUS
        accent_color = 0xfbbf24

        def show(val, default="`par défaut`"):
            if val in (None, "", False):
                return default
            return f"`{val}`"

        title_v = cfg.get(f"{prefix}_title")
        color_v = cfg.get(f"{prefix}_color")
        image_v = cfg.get(f"{prefix}_image")
        footer_v = cfg.get(f"{prefix}_footer")
        ping_default = True if is_welcome else False
        ping_v = cfg.get(f"{prefix}_ping", ping_default)

        count = sum(1 for v in (title_v, color_v, image_v, footer_v) if v)
        if ping_v != ping_default:
            count += 1
        bar_filled = int((count / 5) * 10)
        progress = "█" * bar_filled + "░" * (10 - bar_filled)

        embed = discord.Embed(
            title="Personnalisation Premium",
            description=(
                f"### {surface_label}\n"
                f"`{progress}` **{count}/5** champs personnalisés\n"
                f"Placeholders disponibles · `{{user}}` `{{username}}` `{{guild}}` `{{count}}`\n"
                f"\u200b"
            ),
            color=accent_color,
        )

        embed.add_field(name="Titre", value=show(title_v), inline=False)
        embed.add_field(name="Couleur", value=show(color_v), inline=True)
        embed.add_field(
            name="Ping du membre",
            value="activé" if ping_v else "désactivé",
            inline=True,
        )
        embed.add_field(name="\u200b", value="\u200b", inline=True)

        if image_v and isinstance(image_v, str) and image_v.startswith(("http://", "https://")):
            embed.add_field(
                name="Image bannière",
                value=f"[Lien direct]({image_v}) · aperçu ci-dessous",
                inline=False,
            )
            embed.set_image(url=image_v)
        else:
            embed.add_field(
                name="Image bannière",
                value="`aucune` — clique sur **Image bannière** pour en ajouter",
                inline=False,
            )

        embed.add_field(name="Footer", value=show(footer_v), inline=False)

        if is_welcome:
            dm_on = bool(cfg.get("welcome_dm_enabled", False))
            dm_msg = cfg.get("welcome_dm_message") or ""
            if isinstance(dm_msg, str) and len(dm_msg) > 80:
                dm_msg_display = f"`{dm_msg[:77]}…`"
            elif dm_msg:
                dm_msg_display = f"`{dm_msg}`"
            else:
                dm_msg_display = "`reprend le message principal`"

            if is_plus:
                dm_value = (
                    f"État · {'activé' if dm_on else 'désactivé'}\n"
                    f"Message · {dm_msg_display}"
                )
            else:
                dm_value = (
                    "**Premium+ requis** — envoie un MP automatique "
                    "aux nouveaux membres.\n"
                    "[Débloquer Premium+](https://a7a54eed-3c9d-44cc-9bb5-f542e450c08d-00-7wjyd8rom8cz.janeway.replit.dev/premium)"
                )

            embed.add_field(name="MP de bienvenue", value=dm_value, inline=False)

        embed.set_footer(text=f"Premium actif • Surface : {surface_label} • Session 60s")
        embed.timestamp = discord.utils.utcnow()
        return embed

    async def interaction_check(self, interaction: discord.Interaction) -> bool:
        if not interaction.guild:
            return False
        if interaction.user.id != self.admin_user.id:
            await interaction.response.send_message("❌ Accès réservé à l'utilisateur ayant lancé `/config`.", ephemeral=True)
            return False
        self._reset_inactivity_timer()
        return True


class RoleModal(discord.ui.Modal):
    def __init__(self, config_key, title, view):
        super().__init__(title=f"Configurer {title}")
        self.config_key = config_key
        self.view = view

        self.role_input = discord.ui.TextInput(
            label=get_text(0, "admin.config.modal_role_label"),
            placeholder="123456789012345678",
            required=True,
            max_length=20
        )
        self.add_item(self.role_input)

    async def on_submit(self, interaction: discord.Interaction):
        if not interaction.guild:
            await interaction.response.send_message("❌ Erreur serveur", ephemeral=True)
            return
            
        role_input = self.role_input.value.strip().lower()

        if role_input == 'none':
            config = load_config(interaction.guild.id)
            config[self.config_key] = None
            save_config(interaction.guild.id, config)
            await interaction.response.edit_message(
                embed=self.view.get_config_embed(interaction.guild.id),
                view=self.view
            )
            return

        try:
            role_id = int(role_input)
            role = interaction.guild.get_role(role_id)

            if not role:
                embed = create_embed(
                    "Erreur ❌",
                    "Rôle introuvable. Vérifiez l'ID du rôle.",
                    0xff0000
                )
                await interaction.response.send_message(embed=embed, ephemeral=True)
                return

            config = load_config(interaction.guild.id)
            config[self.config_key] = role_id
            save_config(interaction.guild.id, config)
            print(f"✅ BOOSTER ROLE SAVED: {self.config_key} = {role_id} for guild {interaction.guild.id}")
            # Recharger pour s'assurer que ça s'affiche correctement
            embed = self.view.get_config_embed(interaction.guild.id)
            await interaction.response.edit_message(
                embed=embed,
                view=self.view
            )
            await interaction.followup.send(f"✅ Rôle {role.mention} configuré comme booster XP!", ephemeral=True)

        except ValueError:
            embed = create_embed(
                "Erreur ❌",
                "ID de rôle invalide.",
                0xff0000
            )
            await interaction.response.send_message(embed=embed, ephemeral=True)

class NicknameRequestView(discord.ui.View):
    def __init__(self, user, new_nickname):
        super().__init__(timeout=None)
        self.user = user
        self.new_nickname = new_nickname

    @discord.ui.button(label=get_text(0, "common.accept"), style=discord.ButtonStyle.success, emoji="✅")
    async def accept_button(self, interaction: discord.Interaction, button: discord.ui.Button):
        if not interaction.guild:
            await interaction.response.send_message("❌ Erreur serveur", ephemeral=True)
            return
        
        if not isinstance(interaction.user, discord.Member):
            await interaction.response.send_message("❌ Erreur serveur", ephemeral=True)
            return
            
        if not interaction.user.guild_permissions.manage_nicknames:
            embed = create_embed(
                "Permissions Insuffisantes ❌",
                "Vous n'avez pas les permissions pour gérer les pseudos.",
                0xff0000
            )
            await interaction.response.send_message(embed=embed, ephemeral=True)
            return

        try:
            await self.user.edit(nick=self.new_nickname, reason=f"Demande acceptée par {interaction.user}")

            # MP à l'utilisateur
            try:
                embed = discord.Embed(
                    title=get_text(interaction.guild.id, "admin.nickname.accept_title"),
                    color=0x00ff00
                )
                embed.add_field(name=get_text(interaction.guild.id, "admin.nickname.new_nickname"), value=self.new_nickname, inline=False)
                embed.add_field(name=get_text(interaction.guild.id, "admin.nickname.accepted_by"), value=interaction.user.display_name, inline=False)
                embed.add_field(name=get_text(interaction.guild.id, "common.server"), value=interaction.guild.name, inline=False)
                await self.user.send(embed=embed)
            except:
                pass

            # Mettre à jour le message (SANS la mention ni view)
            embed = discord.Embed(
                title=get_text(interaction.guild.id, "admin.nickname.accept_title"),
                color=0x00ff00
            )
            embed.add_field(name=get_text(interaction.guild.id, "admin.nickname.new_nickname"), value=self.new_nickname, inline=True)
            embed.add_field(name=get_text(interaction.guild.id, "admin.nickname.accepted_by"), value=interaction.user.display_name, inline=True)
            embed.timestamp = discord.utils.utcnow()

            # Edit le message pour supprimer le contenu (mention) et les boutons
            try:
                if interaction.message:
                    await interaction.message.edit(embed=embed, view=None, content="")
            except:
                pass
            await interaction.response.defer()

        except discord.Forbidden:

        action="Choisir: donner ou retirer le rôle"
    )
    @app_commands.default_permissions(manage_roles=True)

        app_commands.Choice(name="Retirer", value="retirer")
    ])
    async def donner_role(self, interaction: discord.Interaction, membre: discord.Member, role: discord.Role, action: str):
        if not interaction.guild:
            return

        await interaction.response.defer()

        # Vérifier que le rôle est gérable par le bot
        if role >= interaction.guild.me.top_role:
            embed = create_embed(
                "Erreur ❌",
                f"Je ne peux pas gérer le rôle {role.mention} (au-dessus ou égal à mon rôle principal).",
                0xff0000
            )

            return

        if action.lower() == "donner":
            if role in membre.roles:
                embed = create_embed(
                    "Erreur ❌",
                    f"{membre.mention} possède déjà le rôle {role.mention}.",
                    0xff0000
                )
                await interaction.followup.send(embed=embed, ephemeral=True)
                return

            if isinstance(interaction.user, discord.Member) and role >= interaction.user.top_role and interaction.user.id != interaction.guild.owner_id:
                embed = create_embed(

                    "Vous ne pouvez pas donner un rôle supérieur ou égal au vôtre.",
                    0xff0000
                )

                return

                await membre.add_roles(role, reason=f"Donné par {interaction.user}")

                    description=f"Le rôle {role.mention} a été attribué à {membre.mention}.",

                    "Je n'ai pas les permissions nécessaires pour donner ce rôle.",
                    0xff0000
                )
                await interaction.followup.send(embed=embed, ephemeral=True)

        elif action.lower() == "retirer":
            if role not in membre.roles:
                embed = create_embed(
                    "Erreur ❌",
                    f"{membre.mention} ne possède pas le rôle {role.mention}.",
                    0xff0000
                )
                await interaction.followup.send(embed=embed, ephemeral=True)
                return

            try:

                embed = discord.Embed(
                    title="❌ Rôle Retiré",
                    description=f"Le rôle {role.mention} a été retiré de {membre.mention}.",

                )

                await interaction.followup.send(embed=embed)

            except discord.Forbidden:
                embed = create_embed(
                    "Erreur ❌",
                    "Je n'ai pas les permissions nécessaires pour retirer ce rôle.",
                    0xff0000
                )

class ServerManagementView(discord.ui.View):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__(timeout=300)
        self.current_page = 0
        self.servers_per_page = 5

    async def get_servers_embed(self, bot):
        guilds = list(bot.guilds)
        total_servers = len(guilds)
        total_members = sum(guild.member_count for guild in guilds)

        # Calculer la pagination
        start_idx = self.current_page * self.servers_per_page
        end_idx = start_idx + self.servers_per_page
        current_guilds = guilds[start_idx:end_idx]
        total_pages = (total_servers + self.servers_per_page - 1) // self.servers_per_page

        embed = discord.Embed(
            title=get_text(0, "admin.servers.manage_title"),
            color=0x7289da
        )

        embed.add_field(
            name="📊 Statistiques Globales",
            value=f"🏰 **{total_servers}** serveurs\n👥 **{total_members:,}** membres au total",
            inline=False
        )

        if current_guilds:
            server_list = ""
            for i, guild in enumerate(current_guilds, start=start_idx + 1):
                owner = guild.owner
                owner_name = f"**{owner.display_name}**" if owner else "Propriétaire inconnu"

                # Créer un vrai lien d'invitation pour rejoindre le serveur
                invite_link = "Aucune permission"
                try:
                    # Trouver le premier salon où on peut créer une invitation
                    for channel in guild.text_channels:
                        if channel.permissions_for(guild.me).create_instant_invite:
                            invite = await channel.create_invite(
                                max_age=3600,  # 1 heure
                                max_uses=1,    # Une seule utilisation
                                unique=True,   # Lien unique
                                reason="Lien d'invitation pour le propriétaire du bot"
                            )
                            invite_link = f"[Rejoindre le serveur]({invite.url})"
                            break
                except Exception:
                    # Si impossible de créer un lien d'invitation
                    invite_link = "Permissions insuffisantes"

                server_list += (
                    f"**{i}.** {guild.name}\n"
                    f"  👑 Propriétaire: {owner_name}\n"
                    f"  🔗 Lien: {invite_link}\n"
                    f"  🆔 ID: `{guild.id}`\n"
                    f"  👥 Membres: {guild.member_count:,}\n"
                    f"  📅 Rejoint le: <t:{int(guild.me.joined_at.timestamp())}:d>\n\n"
                )

            embed.add_field(
                name=f"🏰 Serveurs (Page {self.current_page + 1}/{max(1, total_pages)})",
                value=server_list or "Aucun serveur",
                inline=False
            )

        embed.set_footer(text=f"Version {bot.user.name} • Page {self.current_page + 1}/{max(1, total_pages)}")
        embed.timestamp = discord.utils.utcnow()

        return embed

    @discord.ui.button(label="◀️ Précédent", style=discord.ButtonStyle.secondary, disabled=True)
    async def previous_page(self, interaction: discord.Interaction, button: discord.ui.Button):
        if not interaction.guild:
            return

        self.current_page -= 1

        # Mettre à jour les boutons
        self.previous_page.disabled = (self.current_page == 0)
        total_pages = (len(interaction.client.guilds) + self.servers_per_page - 1) // self.servers_per_page
        self.next_page.disabled = (self.current_page >= total_pages - 1)

        embed = await self.get_servers_embed(interaction.client)
        await interaction.response.edit_message(embed=embed, view=self)

    @discord.ui.button(label="Suivant ▶️", style=discord.ButtonStyle.secondary)
    async def next_page(self, interaction: discord.Interaction, button: discord.ui.Button):
        if not interaction.guild:
            return

        total_pages = (len(interaction.client.guilds) + self.servers_per_page - 1) // self.servers_per_page
        self.current_page += 1

        # Mettre à jour les boutons
        self.previous_page.disabled = (self.current_page == 0)
        self.next_page.disabled = (self.current_page >= total_pages - 1)

        embed = await self.get_servers_embed(interaction.client)
        await interaction.response.edit_message(embed=embed, view=self)

    @discord.ui.button(label="🚪 Quitter un serveur", style=discord.ButtonStyle.danger)
    async def leave_server(self, interaction: discord.Interaction, button: discord.ui.Button):
        if not interaction.guild:

        # SÉCURITÉ: Seul le propriétaire du bot peut utiliser ce bouton

"""
Module Anti-Raid Premium — Une seule commande `/anti-raid` avec toutes les options.

Détection: si N nouveaux membres rejoignent en < W secondes → raid détecté.
Comptes < X jours d'âge sont considérés comme suspects.

Réponse configurable: log / kick / ban / lockdown.
Hiérarchie Discord respectée: propriétaire, admins, modérateurs et membres
avec un rôle >= bot sont toujours ignorés/protégés.
"""
import logging
from collections import deque
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Dict, Deque, Optional

import discord
from discord import app_commands
from discord.ext import commands

from utils.database import load_config, save_config
from utils.premium import (
    has_premium,
    premium_only,
    TIER_PREMIUM,
    OWNER_IDS,
)

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

DEFAULT_CONFIG = {
    "enabled": False,
    "threshold": 5,
    "window": 10,
    "min_account_age_days": 7,
    "action": "lockdown",
    "log_channel_id": None,
}

VALID_ACTIONS = {"log", "kick", "ban", "lockdown"}


def _is_protected(member: discord.Member, guild: discord.Guild) -> bool:
    """
    Retourne True si le membre ne doit JAMAIS être sanctionné par l'anti-raid.
    Respecte la hiérarchie Discord complète.
    """
    if member.bot:
        return True
    if guild.owner_id == member.id:
        return True
    perms = member.guild_permissions
    if perms.administrator:
        return True
    if perms.manage_guild or perms.manage_messages or perms.kick_members or perms.ban_members:
        return True
    # Rôle supérieur ou égal au bot → le bot ne peut pas agir sur eux
    bot_member = guild.me
    if bot_member and member.top_role >= bot_member.top_role:
        return True
    return False


class AntiRaidCog(commands.Cog):
    """Système Anti-Raid Premium en une seule commande."""

    def __init__(self, bot: commands.Bot):
        self.bot = bot
        self._joins: Dict[int, Deque[tuple]] = {}
        self._lockdown_active: Dict[int, bool] = {}

    def _get_config(self, guild_id: int) -> dict:
        full_config = load_config(guild_id)
        ar = full_config.get("anti_raid", {})
        return {**DEFAULT_CONFIG, **ar}

    def _save_config(self, guild_id: int, ar_config: dict) -> None:
        full_config = load_config(guild_id)
        full_config["anti_raid"] = ar_config
        save_config(guild_id, full_config)

    def _is_suspicious(self, member: discord.Member, min_age_days: int) -> bool:
        if not member.created_at:
            return True
        age_days = (datetime.now(timezone.utc) - member.created_at).days
        return age_days < min_age_days

    async def _get_log_channel(self, guild: discord.Guild, config: dict) -> Optional[discord.TextChannel]:
        channel_id = config.get("log_channel_id")
        if channel_id:
            ch = guild.get_channel(int(channel_id))
            if isinstance(ch, discord.TextChannel):
                return ch
        for ch in guild.text_channels:
            if ch.permissions_for(guild.me).send_messages:
                return ch
        return None

    async def _trigger_action(self, guild: discord.Guild, config: dict, suspects: list) -> str:
        """
        Applique l'action configurée sur les suspects.
        Les membres protégés (proprio, admins, rôle >= bot) sont ignorés.
        """
        action = config.get("action", "lockdown")
        if action not in VALID_ACTIONS:
            action = "lockdown"

        if action == "log":
            return f"🔔 **Mode log** — {len(suspects)} suspect(s) détecté(s)."

        if action in ("kick", "ban"):
            success, failed, skipped = 0, 0, 0
            for member in suspects:
                # Vérification hiérarchie avant toute action
                if _is_protected(member, guild):
                    skipped += 1
                    logger.info(f"Anti-Raid: membre protégé ignoré → {member} ({member.id})")
                    continue
                try:
                    if action == "kick":
                        await member.kick(reason="Anti-Raid: vague suspecte")
                    else:
                        await member.ban(reason="Anti-Raid: vague suspecte", delete_message_days=1)
                    success += 1
                except discord.Forbidden:
                    failed += 1
                    logger.warning(f"Anti-Raid: Forbidden pour {action} sur {member.id}")
                except discord.HTTPException as e:
                    failed += 1
                    logger.warning(f"Anti-Raid: HTTPException pour {action} sur {member.id}: {e}")

            verb = "expulsé" if action == "kick" else "banni"
            result = f"⚔️ **{success} {verb}(s)** ({failed} échec(s))"
            if skipped:
                result += f" — {skipped} membre(s) protégé(s) ignoré(s)"
            return result

        if action == "lockdown":
            try:
                everyone = guild.default_role
                locked = 0
                for ch in guild.text_channels:
                    try:
                        perms = ch.overwrites_for(everyone)
                        if perms.send_messages is not False:
                            perms.send_messages = False
                            await ch.set_permissions(everyone, overwrite=perms, reason="Anti-Raid: lockdown")
                            locked += 1
                    except (discord.Forbidden, discord.HTTPException):
                        continue
                self._lockdown_active[guild.id] = True
                return f"🔒 **Lockdown activé** ({locked} salon(s) verrouillé(s)) — Utilise `/anti-raid action:lockdown-off` pour rétablir."
            except discord.Forbidden:
                return "⚠️ Permissions insuffisantes pour le lockdown."
            except discord.HTTPException as e:
                return f"⚠️ Erreur lockdown: {e}"

        return "Aucune action."

    @commands.Cog.listener()
    async def on_member_join(self, member: discord.Member):
        guild = member.guild
        if not guild or member.bot:
            return

        config = self._get_config(guild.id)
        if not has_premium(guild.id, 0, TIER_PREMIUM):
            return

        if not config.get("enabled"):
            return

        threshold = int(config.get("threshold", 5))
        window = int(config.get("window", 10))
        min_age = int(config.get("min_account_age_days", 7))

        now = datetime.now(timezone.utc).timestamp()
        suspicious = self._is_suspicious(member, min_age)

        joins = self._joins.setdefault(guild.id, deque())
        joins.append((now, member.id, suspicious))
        # Purger les entrées hors fenêtre
        while joins and (now - joins[0][0]) > window:
            joins.popleft()

        if len(joins) < threshold:
            return

        # Collecter les suspects (comptes récents) en excluant les membres protégés
        suspect_ids = [mid for _, mid, susp in joins if susp]
        suspects = []
        for mid in suspect_ids:
            m = guild.get_member(mid)
            if m and not _is_protected(m, guild):
                suspects.append(m)

        joins.clear()

        action_result = await self._trigger_action(guild, config, suspects)
        log_ch = await self._get_log_channel(guild, config)
        if log_ch:
            embed = discord.Embed(
                title="🚨 Anti-Raid déclenché",
                description=(
                    f"**{threshold}+ arrivées en {window}s détectées**\n\n"
                    f"Comptes suspects (< {min_age}j): **{len(suspects)}**\n"
                    f"Action: **{config['action']}**\n\n{action_result}"
                ),
                color=0xef4444,
                timestamp=datetime.now(timezone.utc),
            )
            embed.set_footer(text="Miaouscle Bot • Anti-Raid Premium")
            try:
                await log_ch.send(embed=embed)
            except discord.HTTPException:
                pass

        logger.warning(
            f"Anti-Raid déclenché sur {guild.name} ({guild.id}): "
            f"{len(suspects)} suspect(s) — action: {config['action']}"
        )

    async def _check_admin(self, interaction: discord.Interaction) -> bool:
        if not interaction.guild:
            await interaction.response.send_message("❌ Commande à utiliser dans un serveur.", ephemeral=True)
            return False
        if not isinstance(interaction.user, discord.Member):
            return False
        if not interaction.user.guild_permissions.administrator and interaction.user.id not in OWNER_IDS:
            await interaction.response.send_message("❌ Tu dois être administrateur du serveur.", ephemeral=True)
            return False
        return True

    async def _send_status(self, interaction: discord.Interaction):
        config = self._get_config(interaction.guild.id)
        embed = discord.Embed(
            title="🛡️ Anti-Raid — Configuration",
            color=0x34d399 if config.get("enabled") else 0x6b7280,
        )
        embed.add_field(name="État", value="🟢 Activé" if config["enabled"] else "🔴 Désactivé", inline=True)
        embed.add_field(name="Action", value=f"`{config['action']}`", inline=True)
        embed.add_field(
            name="Détection",
            value=(
                f"**{config['threshold']}** arrivées en **{config['window']}s**\n"
                f"Âge mini compte sûr: **{config['min_account_age_days']}j**"
            ),
            inline=False,
        )
        if config.get("log_channel_id"):
            embed.add_field(name="Canal alerte", value=f"<#{config['log_channel_id']}>", inline=False)
        if self._lockdown_active.get(interaction.guild.id):
            embed.add_field(name="🔒 Lockdown", value="**ACTIF**", inline=False)
        embed.add_field(
            name="🛡️ Protection hiérarchie",
            value="Proprio, admins, modérateurs et membres avec rôle ≥ bot sont toujours ignorés.",
            inline=False,
        )
        embed.set_footer(text="Miaouscle Bot • Anti-Raid Premium")
        await interaction.response.send_message(embed=embed, ephemeral=True)

    @app_commands.command(name="anti-raid", description="🛡️ Configurer l'Anti-Raid Premium (toutes les options)")
    @app_commands.describe(
        action="Action à effectuer",
        threshold="Nombre d'arrivées pour déclencher (2-50)",
        window="Fenêtre de détection en secondes (1-600)",
        min_account_age_days="Âge minimum d'un compte pour être considéré sûr (0-365 jours)",
        raid_action="Action à effectuer en cas de raid détecté",
        log_channel="Canal où envoyer les alertes Anti-Raid",
    )
    @app_commands.choices(action=[
        app_commands.Choice(name="📊 Voir le statut", value="status"),
        app_commands.Choice(name="🟢 Activer", value="enable"),
        app_commands.Choice(name="🔴 Désactiver", value="disable"),
        app_commands.Choice(name="⚙️ Configurer (utilise les options ci-dessous)", value="config"),
        app_commands.Choice(name="🔓 Lever le lockdown", value="lockdown-off"),
        app_commands.Choice(name="🧪 Tester la config", value="test"),
    ])
    @app_commands.choices(raid_action=[
        app_commands.Choice(name="🔔 Log uniquement", value="log"),
        app_commands.Choice(name="⚔️ Expulser les suspects", value="kick"),
        app_commands.Choice(name="🔨 Bannir les suspects", value="ban"),
        app_commands.Choice(name="🔒 Lockdown serveur", value="lockdown"),
    ])
    @premium_only(TIER_PREMIUM)
    async def anti_raid(
        self,
        interaction: discord.Interaction,
        action: app_commands.Choice[str],
        threshold: Optional[int] = None,
        window: Optional[int] = None,
        min_account_age_days: Optional[int] = None,
        raid_action: Optional[app_commands.Choice[str]] = None,
        log_channel: Optional[discord.TextChannel] = None,
    ):
        if not await self._check_admin(interaction):
            return

        guild_id = interaction.guild.id
        config = self._get_config(guild_id)

        if action.value == "status":
            await self._send_status(interaction)
            return

        if action.value == "enable":
            config["enabled"] = True
            self._save_config(guild_id, config)
            await interaction.response.send_message("✅ Anti-Raid **activé** sur ce serveur.", ephemeral=True)
            return

        if action.value == "disable":
            config["enabled"] = False
            self._save_config(guild_id, config)
            await interaction.response.send_message("🔴 Anti-Raid **désactivé**.", ephemeral=True)
            return

        if action.value == "config":
            changes = []
            if threshold is not None:
                if threshold < 2 or threshold > 50:
                    await interaction.response.send_message("❌ threshold doit être entre 2 et 50.", ephemeral=True)
                    return
                config["threshold"] = threshold
                changes.append(f"seuil → **{threshold}**")
            if window is not None:
                if window < 1 or window > 600:
                    await interaction.response.send_message("❌ window doit être entre 1 et 600s.", ephemeral=True)
                    return
                config["window"] = window
                changes.append(f"fenêtre → **{window}s**")
            if min_account_age_days is not None:
                if min_account_age_days < 0 or min_account_age_days > 365:
                    await interaction.response.send_message("❌ min_account_age_days entre 0 et 365.", ephemeral=True)
                    return
                config["min_account_age_days"] = min_account_age_days
                changes.append(f"âge mini → **{min_account_age_days}j**")
            if raid_action is not None:
                config["action"] = raid_action.value
                changes.append(f"action → **{raid_action.value}**")
            if log_channel is not None:
                config["log_channel_id"] = log_channel.id
                changes.append(f"canal → {log_channel.mention}")

            if not changes:
                await interaction.response.send_message(
                    "ℹ️ Aucune option fournie. Utilise `threshold`, `window`, `min_account_age_days`, `raid_action` ou `log_channel`.",
                    ephemeral=True,
                )
                return

            self._save_config(guild_id, config)
            await interaction.response.send_message(
                "✅ Configuration mise à jour:\n• " + "\n• ".join(changes),
                ephemeral=True,
            )
            return

        if action.value == "lockdown-off":
            if not self._lockdown_active.get(guild_id):
                await interaction.response.send_message("ℹ️ Aucun lockdown actif.", ephemeral=True)
                return
            await interaction.response.defer(ephemeral=True, thinking=True)
            try:
                everyone = interaction.guild.default_role
                unlocked = 0
                for ch in interaction.guild.text_channels:
                    try:
                        perms = ch.overwrites_for(everyone)
                        if perms.send_messages is False:
                            perms.send_messages = None
                            await ch.set_permissions(everyone, overwrite=perms, reason="Anti-Raid: fin lockdown")
                            unlocked += 1
                    except (discord.Forbidden, discord.HTTPException):
                        continue
                self._lockdown_active[guild_id] = False
                await interaction.followup.send(
                    f"🔓 Lockdown levé. **{unlocked}** salon(s) déverrouillé(s).",
                    ephemeral=True,
                )
            except discord.Forbidden:
                await interaction.followup.send("❌ Permissions insuffisantes.", ephemeral=True)
            except discord.HTTPException as e:
                await interaction.followup.send(f"❌ Erreur: {e}", ephemeral=True)
            return

        if action.value == "test":
            log_ch = await self._get_log_channel(interaction.guild, config)
            embed = discord.Embed(
                title="🧪 Test Anti-Raid",
                description=(
                    f"Config actuelle:\n"
                    f"• Activé: **{config['enabled']}**\n"
                    f"• Seuil: **{config['threshold']}** arrivées en **{config['window']}s**\n"
                    f"• Action: **{config['action']}**\n"
                    f"• Canal alerte: {log_ch.mention if log_ch else '⚠️ Aucun'}\n\n"
                    f"🛡️ **Membres toujours protégés:** proprio, admins, modérateurs, "
                    f"membres avec rôle ≥ bot.\n\n"
                    f"En cas de vrai raid, l'action **{config['action']}** serait exécutée "
                    f"uniquement sur les membres suspects non protégés."
                ),
                color=0xfbbf24,
            )
            await interaction.response.send_message(embed=embed, ephemeral=True)
            return


async def setup(bot: commands.Bot) -> None:
    await bot.add_cog(AntiRaidCog(bot))

def _read_json_sync(path, default):
    try:
        with open(path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:

    except Exception:
        return default


async def _read_json_async(path, default):
    """Lecture JSON dans un thread worker pour ne pas bloquer l'event loop."""
    return await asyncio.to_thread(_read_json_sync, path, default)

class ModeEmploiView(ui.View):
    """View pour la pagination du mode d'emploi."""

    def __init__(self, pages: List[discord.Embed]):
        super().__init__(timeout=300)
        self.pages = pages
        self.current_page = 0

    @ui.button(label="◀️", style=discord.ButtonStyle.gray)
    async def previous_button(self, interaction: Interaction, button: ui.Button) -> None:
        """Bouton page précédente."""
        if self.current_page > 0:
            self.current_page -= 1
            await self._update_view(interaction)
        else:
            await interaction.response.defer()

    @ui.button(label="1️⃣", style=discord.ButtonStyle.primary)
    async def page_1(self, interaction: Interaction, button: ui.Button) -> None:
        """Aller à la page 1."""
        self.current_page = 0
        await self._update_view(interaction)

    @ui.button(label="2️⃣", style=discord.ButtonStyle.primary)
    async def page_2(self, interaction: Interaction, button: ui.Button) -> None:
        """Aller à la page 2."""
        self.current_page = 1
        await self._update_view(interaction)

    @ui.button(label="3️⃣", style=discord.ButtonStyle.primary)
    async def page_3(self, interaction: Interaction, button: ui.Button) -> None:
        """Aller à la page 3."""
        self.current_page = 2
        await self._update_view(interaction)

    @ui.button(label="4️⃣", style=discord.ButtonStyle.primary)
    async def page_4(self, interaction: Interaction, button: ui.Button) -> None:
        """Aller à la page 4."""
        self.current_page = 3
        await self._update_view(interaction)

    @ui.button(label="5️⃣", style=discord.ButtonStyle.primary)
    async def page_5(self, interaction: Interaction, button: ui.Button) -> None:
        """Aller à la page 5."""
        self.current_page = 4
        await self._update_view(interaction)

    @ui.button(label="▶️", style=discord.ButtonStyle.gray)
    async def next_button(self, interaction: Interaction, button: ui.Button) -> None:
        """Bouton page suivante."""
        if self.current_page < len(self.pages) - 1:
            self.current_page += 1
            await self._update_view(interaction)
        else:
            await interaction.response.defer()

    async def _update_view(self, interaction: Interaction) -> None:
        """Met à jour l'affichage de la page."""
        self._update_buttons()
        await interaction.response.edit_message(embed=self.pages[self.current_page], view=self)

    def _update_buttons(self) -> None:
        """Active/désactive les boutons selon la page actuelle."""
        self.previous_button.disabled = (self.current_page == 0)
        self.next_button.disabled = (self.current_page == len(self.pages) - 1)
